intent: Individually authored manner tasks preserve precision, speed, scope, time and explicit conditions.

workshop.title: 对准位置、辨速度、留条件
workshop.instruction: 先移动标记准确对齐，再从原句圈出速度、范围、时间和动作条件。

items.label: exactly：exactly要求位置怎样？
items.material: Measure exactly where the holes should go.
items.reason: exactly要求准确，不是大概猜测。where the holes should go是测量的内容；原句要求测量预定位置，没有给出孔径、距离，也没有说已经打好孔。另给标记只比较对齐与偏移，不是实际打孔尺寸。
items.hint: measure exactly；指令不等于已完成。

exactAlignment.title: 让标记准确对齐
exactAlignment.hint: 另给虚构位置示意：固定的空心圈表示目标位置，移动实心点比较对齐与偏移；不是实际打孔尺寸。
exactAlignment.wrong: 让实心点与目标圈重合；左偏或右偏都不是准确对齐。

options.text: Measure the intended hole positions precisely.
options.reason: exactly修饰measure，要求准确量出位置。

options.text: Guess roughly where the holes should go.
options.reason: roughly与exactly相反，不能把测量改成猜。

options.text: The holes have already been drilled.
options.reason: 指令没有说已经打好孔。

items.label: easily：easily fit说的是哪条船？
items.material: The small boat can easily fit beneath the bridge.
items.reason: easily表示容易地、轻松地，修饰fit。can说明能够，beneath表示在下方。原句只说这条小船能轻松从这座桥下通过，不能扩成所有船或补出实际净空高度。easy变副词要去y加ily：easily。

items.label: slowly：slowly修饰哪个动作？
items.material: Lower the model slowly into the water.
items.reason: 本句lower是动词，表示放低、放下；slowly是副词，说明放下的动作要慢。into the water保留方向，不能改成从水里拿出。祈使句给出要求，不报告已经完成。

items.label: fast：fast要不要再加ly？
items.material: Do not cycle too fast near the entrance.
items.reason: fast本身既可作形容词，也可作副词；这里修饰cycle，不能加ly写成fastly。Do not cycle too fast限制过快的速度，near the entrance限定入口附近，不等于所有地方一律禁止骑车，也没有给出速度数值。

items.label: well：works well评价哪个时间？
items.material: The repaired clock works well now.
items.reason: well在这里是副词，修饰works，表示运转正常。good通常作形容词，不能直接换进works well。repaired说明修过，now限定现在；句子没有保证以后永不出故障。well还可作形容词表示健康，要根据语境判断。

transfer.stem: Which notes correctly describe the boat, the clock and the instruction?
transfer.passage:
A riverside workshop display
Our class was preparing a display about an old riverside workshop. On our plan, a small boat waited beside a bridge. The guide explained, "The small boat can easily fit beneath the bridge." We added the boat and bridge to our model scene.
When the wind picked up, we moved the books indoors quickly. An instruction card for the water display said, "Lower the model slowly into the water." Near the entrance, another notice said, "Do not cycle too fast near the entrance."
The repaired clock works well now. Mrs Lin put it above the display table. Beside it was a photograph of the old workshop after a storm. Its caption read, "The roof was badly damaged in the storm."
Before marking the display board, we were asked to measure exactly where the holes should go. At the pottery section, our teacher was preparing a set of instruction cards. One read, "Carry the hot bowl carefully with both hands." We chose a place for that card beside the bowls.

options.text: The small boat can fit easily; the clock works well now; the instruction asks for both hands.
Every boat fits; the clock can never fail again; one hand is enough.
The small boat can fit easily; the clock can never fail again; the instruction asks for both hands.
The small boat can fit easily; the clock works well now; the bowl has already been carried successfully.

answer.display: The small boat can fit easily; the clock works well now; the instruction asks for both hands.

把now扩大成以后永不出故障。
